text: so ok im trying to understand what that means exactly. are u saying that the single file props are to go away?
resolution: Clarified what the migration means: only the per-prop RENDER CODE goes away (the ~15 bespoke React components that hand-draw meshes, replaced by one generic renderer), while each prop's SHAPE stays as a self-contained single-file asset. The user confirmed the intent (single-file self-contained assets) and refined it into req_0796: the compiler MINES each asset's shape into flat positional/size data rather than anyone hand-writing a recipe. No code owned by this id — it's a Q&A that set the direction now realized by req_0796's mineProp (committed a04e7a1e7). No commit.
